text: {"lessons":["Selling winners too quickly can forfeit further gains; I should base exits on my investment thesis and risk limits, not the pleasure of locking in profit.","Selling a losing position is painful, but holding it just to avoid realizing a loss is no reason to keep it; reassess the thesis objectively.","A few trades have not established a reliable strategy, so I should avoid reacting to short-term account swings and make deliberate, diversified decisions."]}
